findings.title: DNSSEC not enabled
findings.description: Zone is not DNSSEC-signed; DNS answers can be spoofed/tampered
findings.remediation: Enable DNSSEC signing at the registrar/DNS provider

findings.title: MTA-STS not deployed
findings.description: No MTA-STS policy; inbound-mail TLS can be stripped (downgrade)
findings.remediation: Publish an MTA-STS policy and _mta-sts TXT record

findings.title: SPF not hard-fail
findings.description: SPF ends in ~all/?all rather than -all; spoofed mail may still pass
findings.remediation: Use -all once senders are enumerated

findings.title: JWT Token exposed
findings.remediation: Rotate/revoke the credential and remove it from client-served content
